title: Count Good Meals
summary: Given an array of integers representing the deliciousness of each food item, count the number of unique pairs of different foods where the sum of their deliciousness values is a power of two.
statement: Given an array of integers representing the deliciousness of each food item, count the number of unique pairs of different foods where the sum of their deliciousness values is a power of two. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Nonnegative values; choose two distinct indices.
Count index pairs whose sum is a positive power of two, modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: When processing one value, every earlier complement for each power of two forms one new pair.
Count prior values and query power-value across the finite power range.
Add counts[2^bit-value] for each bit, then increment this value; reduce the total modulo M.
Each unordered index pair is counted once when its later endpoint arrives and exactly for its unique sum.
editorial: Each unordered index pair is counted once when its later endpoint arrives and exactly for its unique sum.

tests.explanation: Valid pairs sum to four, eight, or sixteen, giving four pairs.
Index multiplicities produce fifteen good pairs.
